types.name: Fenrir::EntityValue
types.doc: A C# Entity: an entity's 32-bit value alone. The wrapper a native takes or returns where C# passes an Entity, and the field a shared struct holds where C# holds one.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::Contact
types.doc: One contact of a body, as of the last step.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The body entity (a rigid body or a character body) asked about.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: The body's collider touching.

fields.name: otherBody
fields.doc: The body entity (a rigid body or a character body) it touches.

fields.name: otherCollider
fields.doc: That body's collider.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: Where they touch, in world space.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: World space, unit length, pointing from Body to OtherBody.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::MoveCastHit
types.doc: Where a moved shape is blocked (PhysicsWorld.MoveCast).

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The entity of the body that blocked the shape.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: The entity of the collider that blocked it.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: Where the shape touches the body, on the shape, in world space.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The body's surface normal where it was touched, pointing towards the shape.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: How far the shape can travel along the motion and stay clear of the body: the safe distance.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::OverlapHit
types.doc: A body a shape or point overlaps.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The entity of the body.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: The entity of the collider.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::PenetrationHit
types.doc: A body a shape overlaps, and how to get out of it (PhysicsWorld.Penetrations).

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The entity of the body.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: The entity of the collider.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: The shape's deepest point inside the collider, in world space.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The unit direction that moves the shape out of the collider along the shortest path.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: How far along Normal the shape must move to stop overlapping the collider: more than 0.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::QueryFilter
types.doc:
Which bodies a query can find. New, it finds every body except triggers.

The default value (every field zero, which as written would find nothing) finds what a new one does, so a query function can take `default` as its filter.

fields.name: mask
fields.doc: The collision layers to find, one bit per layer: a body is found if it is in any of them.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc:
The layers the query is in, one bit per layer: when non-zero, a body is found only if its CollisionFilter mask includes one of them, the rule two bodies collide by. 0 when new, which ignores bodies' masks, so a ray still finds a hitbox that collides with nothing.

To find what a body would collide with, filter as it does: `new QueryFilter { Mask = cf.Mask, Layers = cf.Layers, IgnoreBody = me }`, with `cf` its CollisionFilter (or a new one).

fields.name: ignoreBody
fields.doc: A body never found, such as the one casting the query. None when new.

fields.name: hitTriggers
fields.doc: Whether triggers are found.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::RaycastHit
types.doc: Where a ray hit a body.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The entity of the body hit.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: The entity of the collider hit.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: Where the ray met the surface, in world space.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The surface's normal at Point, pointing out of the body.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: How far along the ray Point is: 0 for a ray that starts inside a body.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptQueries::ShapeCastHit
types.doc: Where a cast shape hit a body.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The entity of the body hit.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: The entity of the collider hit.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: Where the cast shape touches the body, on the cast shape, in world space.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The body's surface normal where it was hit, pointing towards the cast shape.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: How far the shape travelled before it touched: 0 for a shape that starts touching.
